identity.title: T2T genome assembly and CRISPR/Cas9 editing of Medicago lupulina.

content.abstract: A complete, gap-free genome of Medicago lupulina, a tough, high-protein forage legume, and a gene-editing tool for this species, which was used to alter its leaf shape, provide key resources for improving alfalfa and breeding better forage crops for high-altitude environments.
